Executes a command in a runtime session container and streams the output back to the caller. This operation allows you to run shell commands within the agent runtime environment and receive real-time streaming responses including standard output and standard error. To invoke a command, you must specify the agent runtime ARN and a runtime session ID. The command execution supports streaming responses, allowing you to receive output as it becomes available through contentStart , contentDelta ,…
